analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold at 32.0. MACD histogram improving to -0.0017 but remains negative. ADX at 31.5 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is stronger than +DI. Volume ratio below 1 for 5 consecutive days shows lack of buying pressure. Current price of $0.19 is 10.9% above 52-week low of $0.14, still a low position. Potential for Higher Low forming from 5-day low of $0.18 against 20-day low of $0.18, but low volume lacks conviction. Entry requires confirmation of $0.20 resistance breakout with accompanying volume.

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Entry requires confirmation of resistance breakout with accompanying volume.
